title: On-device LLM silicon ships 1-PFLOP deskside + sandbox-runtime specs by H1 2027
body: Nvidia's GTC Taipei keynote this morning June 1 paired silicon and sandbox runtime in one reference. The RTX Spark Superchip — 20 Arm CPU cores co-designed with MediaTek, a Blackwell GPU with 6,144 CUDA cores, 128GB unified LPDDR5X on TSMC 3nm — hits 1 petaflop FP4 and runs 120B-parameter LLMs at 1M-token context locally, debuting in the Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra with ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI follow-ons fall 2026. The DGX Station for Windows on GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra delivers 20 petaflops FP4 at 748GB memory running Nvidia OpenShell for Windows — the agent runtime jointly developed with Microsoft, Canonical, IBM Red Hat that enforces security controls on agent invocations via Windows security primitives — Q4 2026 from Dell, HP, ASUSTeK, MSI, Supermicro. The structural force is procurement-side coupling between silicon and sandbox runtime: once one vendor publicly ships a deskside 1-petaflop FP4 baseline paired with a named OS-sandbox runtime running 120B-parameter local inference inside an enterprise envelope, every peer on-device silicon stack faces an RFP question — does your silicon hit the petaflop FP4 floor at the laptop tier, does your runtime expose host-OS sandbox primitives at agent-invocation granularity, and do you ship them as one bundle. Named cohort under pressure: Apple M-series + Core ML / MLX heading into WWDC June 8, Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite 2 + Hexagon NPU on Windows on Arm, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ + ROCm-on-Windows, Intel Lunar Lake / Panther Lake + OpenVINO. By H1 2027 we expect at least two of Apple, Qualcomm, AMD, Intel to publish deskside-class on-device LLM specs matching the petaflop FP4 floor with a paired OS-sandbox runtime at agent-invocation granularity, plus one industry body (MLCommons MLPerf Client, the Confidential Computing Consortium, or an OpenSSF on-device agent SIG) drafting a profile naming the pairing as baseline. Bear case is a peer ships a divergent spec (NPU-only without GPU FP4, or a runtime omitting host-OS sandbox primitives) that fragments convergence before two vendors align; absent that, H1 2027 lands the first peer matching specs and the first industry-body draft.

reasoning.because: RTX Spark hits 1 PFLOP FP4 + 120B local LLMs paired with OpenShell sandbox in Surface Laptop Ultra
reasoning.given: One silicon-plus-runtime bundle in a Microsoft-co-branded device forces peer silicon to match
reasoning.so_that: At least two of Apple, Qualcomm, AMD, Intel publish matching specs and an industry body drafts a profile
reasoning.landing: By H1 2027; two peer-vendor specs plus one industry-body draft profile
reasoning.plain_language: Nvidia just put a supercomputer-class chip inside a laptop with built-in safety controls. Rival chipmakers will copy the bundle within a year.

summary: Nvidia's RTX Spark (1 PFLOP FP4, 120B local LLMs, 128GB unified memory) ships in Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra fall 2026 paired with OpenShell sandbox, plus DGX Station for Windows GB300 deskside Q4 2026. By H1 2027 two of Apple, Qualcomm, AMD, Intel publish matching specs.
